newsitem.title: JAPAN: KDD to clarify undersea cable report on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: KDD to clarify undersea cable report on Thursday.

text.p: Kokusai Denshin Denwa Co Ltd (KDD) declined to comment on Tuesday on a newspaper report that it plans to lay an undersea cable around Japan but added that its president would clarify the issue on Thursday.

"We have no comment on the report today. We have a regular news conference by the president on Thursday and we will clarify the issue on that occasion," a company spokeswoman said. The Japanese economic daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Tuesday that KDD would invest about 100 billion yen in laying an undersea optical fibre cable around three of Japan's main islands by the summer of 1999.
KDD, an international telecommunications operator, will hold the news conference at 1 p.m. (0400 GMT) on Thursday, the KDD spokeswoman said.
